display_long_description:
Welcome to Monke Mania!

Monke Mania is a fan-made monkey VR game where you can run, climb, and mess around with other players. Explore different maps, practice your movement skills, find secrets, and hang out with friends. Whether you're trying to master advanced routes or just looking to have fun, there's always something to do.

This game was made by fans who love movement-based VR games and wanted to create their own experience for the community. We're constantly working on new updates, maps, cosmetics, and features to make the game even better.

So grab your friends, become a monke, and join the mania!

 What you can do:

Climb and move using your hands
Explore fun maps
Play with friends online
Unlock and wear cool cosmetics
Find hidden secrets
Enjoy regular updates and new content

See you in Monke Mania! -Kota
